bookingOpens: By phone. Guests from abroad are pointed by the restaurant's site to byFood (English) and TasteTrip (Chinese), which book on their behalf.
cancellation: Through byFood: free cancellation up to three days before; no refund within three days or for no-shows.
groups: Private rooms cost an extra ¥5,000 at lunch and ¥8,000 at dinner, unless guests are moved there because the counter and tables are full.
children: Parties with children aged 14 or under must book a private room; the children may order à la carte instead of a course.
